WITH signatures(signature) AS (VALUES
('can_access_course_as_learner(uuid)'),('_paid_20260922_lesson_read(uuid,boolean,boolean)'),
('_test_manual_credit(uuid)'),('_test_session_payload(uuid)'),('_test_grade_payload(uuid)'),
('_test_normalize_options(jsonb,integer)'),('_test_attempt_limits(uuid,uuid)'),
('_assert_test_learner_access(uuid)'),('start_test_attempt(uuid,uuid)'),('submit_test_attempt(uuid,jsonb)'),
('_final_test_photo_required(uuid)'),('account_deletion_access_allowed()')),
tables(name) AS (VALUES('lessons'),('course_modules'),('lesson_progress'),('course_manual_credits')),
payload AS(SELECT jsonb_build_object('status','UC014_METADATA_ONLY','captured_at',clock_timestamp(),'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',s.signature,'found',p.oid IS NOT NULL,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'definition',CASE WHEN p.oid IS NOT NULL THEN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)END,'definition_md5',CASE WHEN p.oid IS NOT NULL THEN md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))END) ORDER BY s.signature)FROM signatures s LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=to_regprocedure('public.'||s.signature)),
'relations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t.name,'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid))ORDER BY a.attnum)FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid=to_regclass('public.'||t.name)AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true))ORDER BY c.conname)FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid=to_regclass('public.'||t.name)),'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid))ORDER BY c.relname)FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid=to_regclass('public.'||t.name)))ORDER BY t.name)FROM tables t))value)
SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(value::text)>262144 THEN jsonb_build_object('status','OVERSIZE_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE') ELSE value END metadata FROM payload;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._final_test_photo_required(p_lesson_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT c.require_final_test_photo AND l.id = (
    SELECT candidate.id FROM public.lessons candidate
    LEFT JOIN public.course_modules m ON m.id = candidate.module_id AND m.course_id = candidate.course_id
    WHERE candidate.course_id = c.id AND candidate.type = 'test'
    ORDER BY (m.id IS NULL) DESC, m.order_index DESC NULLS FIRST,
      m.id DESC NULLS FIRST, candidate.order_index DESC, candidate.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) FROM public.lessons l JOIN public.courses c ON c.id = l.course_id
  WHERE l.id = p_lesson_id AND l.type = 'test'), false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._paid_20260922_lesson_read(p_lesson_id uuid, p_allow_demo boolean, p_allow_learner boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_course_id uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT l.course_id INTO v_course_id FROM public.lessons l WHERE l.id=p_lesson_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Reserved interface only: no demo UUIDs exist, and mutable flags grant nothing.
 RETURN public._paid_20260922_course_read(v_course_id,p_allow_learner);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._test_manual_credit(p_lesson_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_credit jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- The following migration installs the manual-credit table. Safe during rollout.
  IF to_regclass('public.course_manual_credits') IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('creditedAt', mc.credited_at, 'creditedBy', mc.credited_by)
    INTO v_credit
  FROM public.course_manual_credits mc
  JOIN public.enrollments e ON e.id = mc.enrollment_id
  JOIN public.lessons l ON l.course_id = e.course_id
  WHERE l.id = p_lesson_id AND e.user_id = auth.uid() AND mc.revoked_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY mc.credited_at DESC LIMIT 1;
  RETURN v_credit;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._test_session_payload(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE s public.test_attempt_sessions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT s FROM public.test_attempt_sessions WHERE id = p_session_id;
  RETURN public._test_attempt_limits(s.lesson_id, s.user_id) || jsonb_build_object(
    'attemptId', s.id, 'startedAt', s.started_at, 'status', s.status,
    'questions', public._test_public_questions(s.questions_snapshot, false),
    'passingScore', s.passing_score, 'showAnswers', s.show_answers);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_deletion_access_allowed()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_revocations WHERE user_id=auth.uid());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_course_as_learner(_course_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.enrollments e
    JOIN public.courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
    JOIN public.profiles p
      ON p.user_id = e.user_id
     AND p.organization_id = c.organization_id
    WHERE e.user_id = auth.uid()
      AND e.course_id = _course_id
      AND e.status IN ('active', 'completed')
      -- Keep the existing SINTAGMA enrollment contract: completion preserves
      -- course access even when the original access period has elapsed.
      AND (
        e.expires_at IS NULL
        OR e.expires_at > now()
        OR e.status = 'completed'
      )
  )
$function$
